title: Dust-Lock Porter
text: Dust-Lock Porter collects abandoned tools and seals them into a walking cabinet of prison iron. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The key hangs inside the lock.

defeatReward.text: Dust-Lock Porter is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
